reviews.comment: Doesn't share the slides w/ students but gives time in class to write everything down. Loved the content of the class & shes a great prof, she's really caring towards students! She gives 10 extra credit opportunities, but your grade is based on only 4 tests. the final is the 4th test, not cumulative. I would rec to only buy the sage readings book
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor is seriously the best! People who have a problem with her "politic agenda" are ridiculous. She is extremely smart, very caring, and her class is easy. Show up to class for your grade. Period. You're not paying to not go to class. Don't be lazy. Tests are a cake walk, and you will get an A if you come to class. Thank you Professor Huey. :)

Not my favorite professor, but she was decent. Lectures were really boring and slow, and she expects group participation. She won't post the slides or let you take pictures of them, so you have to go to class if you want the material. Also, she assigns readings and will test over them. Class is based on 4 exams, but she gives enough extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved her. Failed the first test (bc I didn't know how to study) and she met with me multiple times to help me study for the next one. Gave me accommodations for mental health even though disability services hadn't yet. Grades are like 4 tests, never got the textbook, and she gives so much extra credit. She's super nice and funny.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As it’s been said a million times, I seriously don’t sympathize with the lower ratings. Her lectures are engaging, she cares about you and understands you’re a student as well, and you can get by just by going to class and making a Quizlet before the test! Easy A if you just show up- she’s a cool lady. Take her!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I am not sure why she has such poor ratings because this class was so nice! Honestly a very easy A if you just take notes and study a little bit. She likes to act tough and like her class is impossible, but it's not. She is funny and makes the lectures enjoyable. There are 4 multiple choice tests and extra credit. Super easy class, take her!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Love this class! Professor Huey is very sarcastic and wants her students to be engaged in class. The material is super interesting and if you pay attention in class, it's an easy A. Lectures are a bit slow paced, so you kind of have to fight to stay focused.

I don’t understand why Professor Huey has poor ratings. She is very dry-humored and is very intelligent. She’s clearly liberal (totally fine), which doesn’t always go over so well with the people at A&M. Overall, she’s great, tests are easy, and she has extra credit.

Shes pretty chill and relatable but takes learning the material seriously. You must show up to class and take notes; shes pretty specific on her tests. Your grade is based only on 3 (fairly challenging) tests and 1 easier paper. Gives LOTS of extra credit pop quizzes! She basically just reads from a PowerPoint but engages with the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Erratic when it comes to guidelines & expectations. She often takes specific examples from lectures for exam questions, be sure to write everything she says. She makes things harder than necessary. Refuses to share slides & can't seem to answer simple questions - makes smart-aleck remarks. Office hours before exam 1 are a must to pass it. Sloppy.

Class is very test heavy, which can catch you off guard if you do bad on the 1st one, but she makes it worth less of your overall grade so that you can get used to her style of questions. We had 1 essay which she made super easy to understand and write. Lots of extra credit quizzes that matched up to a whole letter grade. Very possible to do well!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Gives a lot of extra credit opportunities! She is really funny and I found her lectures very interesting. The tests are really hard so make sure to study a lot especially the second one. Don't get the textbook you can find it online for free.

The way she handles the class is outstandingly lazy. Only professor i have taken on A&M that does not care to stand up her seat and teach her class properly, shows up to read a powerpoint and does not share any class info on canvas such as slides for obviously personal reasons. These two things make the class harder than it should
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Huey is such a great person. She makes confusing sociology topics so much easier to digest, by comparing it to modern stuff that she knows (or at least thinks haha) we'll relate to. She is really open to conversations about class topics and will do everything to help her students. The class is just a lot of lectures, but they're helpful.

Nice, understanding, conveys lecture material very well, easy to pay attention. You should never skip class as her exams directly pull from lectures and she does not post slides. Some easy readings but not mandatory, exams directly from notes/lectures. Pay attention during class and review notes and you get an A. LOTS of extra credit opportunities.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Huey genuinely cares about her students and their success, she's extremely helpful in office hours. There are only 3 exams and an expert panel paper but it is nothing too difficult. If you do not want to put any effort in it will get very difficult very quickly. However, if you study and meet with her if you have an issue, you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Harsh grading. Lectures are extremely disorganized and hard to follow. Lectures to own political agenda. She often doesn't know the answer to questions asked in class. Gives very helpful extra credit quizzes in class. Careful with GroupMes, she tried to take away everyone's extra credit cause of a previous quiz that was discussed. Brutal reading.

I was not expecting this class to be easy but it was unnecessarily hard. She is very nice and gives extra credit quizzes which help a TON, but there were only 3 exams (including the final) and an essay to write. She is a nice prof and her lectures are good, but her exams are tough and typically based on her examples that are not ever taught.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was hard for me due to the fact that your grade is based off 3 tests and one paper. There is a bit of extra credit. I wasn't a huge fan of the lectures and thought a lot of the test questions were trying to trick you. Unless you study a bunch, you will not do well.

Tough grader with confusing exams. Only grades are three exams and one paper. She has no sympathy and if you fail she blames it on you, not her teaching or bad framework of her exams. She gets through like two slides a day and doesn't share her slides. Hard to get an A!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: tells unfunny jokes

Explanations of concepts and theory are extremely superficial and examples she gives can actually disprove the point she's trying to make. Refused to answer emails from me and many others while Canvas was down during finals, then proceeded to send out a mass email saying she had no idea what was wrong but everything is okay.

Where do I begin. Don't waste your time on this prof. Don't try to email her, you wont get a response unless you ask her how HER day went and her stress. Don't expect anything from her. Oh and if you try to schedule a zoom meeting with her about your grade she will either ignore you or cancel. Reads off a script and has no idea what shes teaching.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She's awesome, she really cares about her students and wants us to learn. The transition to online learning was rough because of COVID but she did her best to make the transition as smooth as possible and be considerate of all our needs.

Professor Huey is a very enthusiastic professor and cares about her students, which is very nice! Her lectures convey important data but the discussion seems superficial in terms of concept explanation and examples given can potentially undermine the concept she is discussing. Very caring prof but quite superficial in explaining concepts.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Offers extra credit for attendance which helped a TON. Keeps things really simple and understandable. Memorized all of our names super quickly and genuinely cared that she was teaching us well.

Professor Huey was awesome! She has tons of videos which makes the class topics much more interesting. Class attendance isn't required but going to class helps your grade out so much because of the quizzes! As long as you read the required material before class, the extra quizzes are a breeze! She also respects everyone's opinion/comments. Easy A!

They're alright as a professor. Friendly, but otherwise uninteresting and only knowledgeable of surface-level data. My advice is to take the class and keep your head down. If you disagree with what she says, don't bother stating your disagreements. It wastes time and changes nothing. Just keep your head down and answer as she wants you to.

One of the best profs I've had! Her lectures are entertaining and she is always available for questions. You need the lecture notes to do well on tests, so go to class because she doesn't post her stuff online. She also gives out extra credit quizzes if you attend lecture. Overall, AMAZING PROF!!

she has NEVER included her own political views into any lecture, test, quiz or reading and my grade was never reflective of political understanding even tho some students claim this. Her lectures are not posted but come to class- were in college to learn not be bums. Her tests and quizzes are based off of lectures and readings-lots of extra credit

Eileen has been the BEST professor I've ever had. Her criminology course was wonderful, and her lectures were engaging and interesting. Lots of extra credit opportunity, and if you show up to class and study for her tests, an A is 100% doable. She is so caring and accessible, take her!

Eileen is one of the best soci professors out there! She is super understanding and always makes class clear and fun. She always speaks facts and supplies them with research. If you have a chance to take her please do!

Quite frankly one of the best profs Ive taken in my time here at TAMU. She cares for her students and wants you to succeed. Gives extra credit quizzes as incentive to go to class (which is not mandatory), and is easily accessible if you need help. She knows her stuff!! 10/10 would recommend taking any of her classes, she is AWESOME!!!

Prof Huey has become one of my favorite teachers. There are 3 tests (last one is the final) and the 1st one is worth less points. One paper & she reads each paper 2ce to grade fairly. Study the notes & book to reinforce the material and you'll do well. The bad reviews are just from people who don't study & debate aggressively over class topics.

TAKE THIS CLASS!!! The content is very interesting and the course load is manageable. Miss Huey is super knowledgeable on the content and is quick to give personal examples that are interesting and help get the point across. Lectures aren't mandatory but are genuinely interesting. There are so many opportunities for extra credit and lots of laughs.

Huey is a great professor. Her lectures are very detailed and if you go to class and take great notes you will have a great resource to study when it comes to the time of exam prep. She offers extra quizzes to reward students who come to class. 1 essay requirement and she grades very fairly. She is VERY smart and knows her stuff. Take her!!!!!

If I could give a higher rating, I would. Huey really cares about how you do in the class and is more than willing to help out. She is very clear about expectations and she has a wonderful personality. This class has a lot of controversial topics, and she handles everything professionally, presenting only empirical data. I would 100% recommend Huey

This class is very straightforward and easy to succeed in. Professor Huey is hilarious and truly cares about her students and their success. Attendance isn't mandatory, but there are multiple extra credit quizzes given so go to class to get those points. Only grades are exams and a paper, none of which are difficult.

I loved mrs. Huey!! I would take any course she teaches. She really cares about her students to the point where she will learn your name! Its easy to succeed in the class but you must participate. You get out of it what you put into it. Shes very caring and provides so. much. extra. credit! 10/10 would recommend!
Lots of reading and test heavy, but a great prof. She know's what she's talking about and loves it too. Get to know her and you won't regret it.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I cannot recommend her enough! She is very direct and plays no tricks with the tests, she tells you exactly what to expect. 3 tests, 1 paper (not hard at all) and 10 extra credit quizzes (given as an incentive to attend her class). She cares about all of her students and wants to see them succeed. My favorite class this semester!
Very good professor. Would 100% recommend. She is always there to help. You write one paper that isn't that hard. There are extra credit quizzes which only boost your grade. Take her, she's amazing.

I love Ms. Huey! She really cares about her students and gives you plenty of extra credit! Extra credit is given through pop quizzes. Exams are straightforward - go over slides and textbook (briefly) and you'll get an A :)

Miss Huey was so great! She really makes the material understandable and relatable for her students. Attendance isn't mandatory, but if you show up you're pretty much guaranteed to make an A. She's super funny and absolutely adorable.

By far my favorite professor Ive yet to have! She gives extra credit quizzes but as a result is strict with test and paper grading. She is easy to reach and not intimidating which helps you with asking questions to better understand the course.

She is understanding and gives out extra credit, BUT they are pop quizzes. You have to read to get the questions, and these help on the tests she gives. She also doesn't give out test reviews. For the sake of the test/grade, what she says goes, don't argue it.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: she is nice lady very laid back and chill about a lot of things. i really enjoyed her class a lot even though i did not really go much. the majority of the material is from the book and there are 3 tests and 1 paper, nothing too extreme. there are extra points you can get by going to class and it will HELP you!!! take her shes awesome!
